nota: Los textos de los paneles de estudio en esta lengua. Salieron de `paneles.json` el 2026-09-14: con las ocho dentro, aquel fichero pasaba de 22 KB contra un tope de 16.384. El fichero de hechos se queda con el modelo, la medida y el entorno; esto trae el nombre, lo que hace y lo que falla.

charla-web.que_hace: Responds about PreceptorOS with the actual installation commands and recognizes those who have already installed it instead of repeating the steps.
charla-web.que_falla: Makes up figures with a lot of confidence. If it gives you a number, ask where it comes from: this is the actual flaw that this panel exists to highlight.
charla-web.para_quien: Those who arrive for the first time and want to install without reading the repository.

coder-adapter.que_hace: Lives in the terminal and writes code, tests and checks inside the PreceptorOS ecosystem. Today it runs on the measured base model: 32.03 tok/s with the machine at 1.04 — second fastest on the bench, because it activates 3B of the 30 it weighs.
coder-adapter.que_falla: The specialised adapter does NOT exist yet: today this is the base model with rules on top, not a LoRA trained for this house. And its declared flaw carries over: it forges fast and trusts its own hand. If you do not ask for the test, it hands you the piece untempered.
coder-adapter.para_quien: Someone who already installed and wants the ecosystem to build itself from the terminal.

killswitch-apocalypse.que_hace: A ten-minute study where the pressure is a battery, not a stopwatch. You practise the only thing that works when the cloud goes quiet: asking well and checking what you are told.
killswitch-apocalypse.que_falla: The clock is real and does not pause. If you get lost on the first question, the run ends with the file half done — and that defeat is part of the study, not a bug in the game.
killswitch-apocalypse.para_quien: Anyone who wants to know what they would do without web services, with what is already in their hand.
